_comment: LIVE sponsor file, fetched by the extension. LIMITS ARE ENFORCED BY REJECTION, NOT TRUNCATION: an entry that breaks one is skipped and the slot shows the next valid entry, or nothing. headline <= 80 chars, body <= 140, advertiser <= 40. headline, advertiser and clickUrl are required. clickUrl and imageUrl must be https AND on https://winnow-reviews.vercel.app. body, imageUrl and viewUrl may be null. A list rotates: one entry is chosen per render. Check the popup actually fills after editing — a rejected entry looks exactly like no sponsor.
headline: Seven ways to spot a fake Amazon review
body: The checks Winnow runs, explained so you can do them yourself in a minute.
